description: This file is part of the vtiger CRM project and handles the mass edit functionality for modules, preparing data and rendering the MassEditForm template.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRMEntity acts as a base class for module entities, providing a factory method to get module-specific instances.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template class tailored for vtiger CRM, used for rendering views.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: A static method to instantiate a CRMEntity object for a specific module.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the view mode based on the current focus mode.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves the blocks of fields for the module in a certain view.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Gets the parent tab (category) for the current module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID corresponding to the current module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation metadata for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into structured arrays for field names, datatypes, and labels.
